card.title: A Valuable Safeguard
card.instruction: Treat every delay, restriction, and extra step as evidence that the system is becoming safer and more thorough.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our school trip now needs two signatures on every consent form. Reassuring.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the only teacher here. We'll have to wait for June.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Independent eyes before any child boards a bus.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: June wrote the forms. She wants someone else to check her work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better. We've found a safeguard our second safeguard needed. Who's checking that third person?

mechanism: A interprets every added independence requirement in consent checking as proof of increasingly thorough protection.
confusable: Unlike neutral compliance, A celebrates each new delay and immediately seeks the next safeguard.
comparison: Reviewer independence creates recursive checking, unlike the climbing wall's safety through nonoperation.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
